summary.name: Ludo.ai
summary.one_liner: Ludo.ai is an AI game asset generator that creates sprites, animated spritesheets, icons, UI, textures, 3D models, music, sound effects, and video for game developers.
keywords: ai game art for indie devs
use_cases: Generating animated character spritesheets (idle, walk, attack)
Creating 2D game art such as icons, UI, backgrounds and textures
Producing 3D character models with rigging for Unity, Unreal or Godot
Making background music and sound effects for a game
Generating game cutscenes, trailers and animated portraits
Giving coding agents the ability to create and export game assets into a repo
summary.what_it_does: Ludo.ai generates 2D game art (sprites, icons, UI, textures, backgrounds) in over 30 pre-defined art styles or a user-supplied style reference. Its Sprite Generator produces animated sprite sheets from a prompt or character image, with pixel art and up to 8-direction options, and exports them as transparent PNG sheets with JSON atlases. The 3D Generator creates textured models with PBR textures and GLTF/GLB export, and can auto-rig humanoids and apply animation presets. Audio tools generate music, sound effects and voice, and a video generator makes short clips. A CLI, MCP server, REST API and Unity plugin let coding agents and pipelines generate assets directly.
notable: Sprite sheet generation with idle, walk, attack and other motion presets, plus 8-direction sprites
Follow-up prompt editing keeps the style and identity of an existing asset
CLI and MCP server for coding agents like Claude Code and Codex
3D models with auto-rigging and 640+ animation presets
caveats: Free tier gives 30 starting credits with no card; paid plans (Indie, Pro, Studio, Enterprise) add credits for generation
CLI, MCP server and API calls draw credits, and are included on paid plans
3D mesh complexity and some features depend on the plan chosen
